user.title: Create Window Group
user.description: Configure a window group with shared facade orientation and slat geometry. You can add covers to this group after setup.

data_description.name: A descriptive name for this window group (e.g., 'South Windows')
data_description.slat_width_mm: Width of each slat in millimeters (note: for Z-profile slats, use the effective projected width, e.g. ~80mm for Z-90)
data_description.slat_spacing_mm: Spacing between slats in millimeters (note: for Z-profile slats, use the Lamellenteilung/pitch, not the visible gap)
data_description.safety_margin_deg: Extra degrees added to calculated angle to ensure full sun blockage (compensates for measurement and actuator tolerances)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Window Group
reconfigure.description: Update the facade orientation and slat geometry for this window group.

data_description.slat_width_mm: Width of each slat in millimeters (note: for Z-profile slats, use the effective projected width, e.g. ~80mm for Z-90)
data_description.slat_spacing_mm: Spacing between slats in millimeters (note: for Z-profile slats, use the Lamellenteilung/pitch, not the visible gap)
data_description.safety_margin_deg: Extra degrees added to calculated angle to ensure full sun blockage (compensates for measurement and actuator tolerances)

abort.already_configured: A window group with this name already exists.

user.title: Cover & Tilt Settings
user.description: Select a cover entity and configure its tilt behavior.

data_description.name: Optional custom name for this cover
data_description.drive_position: Position to drive cover to before tilting (0%=closed, 100%=open)
data_description.invert_tilt_percent: Invert tilt percent if cover uses reversed semantics
data_description.minimum_tilt_change_percent: Only adjust tilt if change exceeds this threshold (reduces motor wear)

protection.title: Protection Options
protection.description: Configure reflection protection and manual close detection.

data_description.reflection_protection_enabled: Automatically keep minimum tilt after the sun has passed the facade to prevent glare from reflected light (e.g., from balconies). Deactivates when the sun sets. Without reflection protection, the cover fully opens when the sun is no longer hitting the facade.
data_description.reflection_protection_min_tilt: Minimum tilt to maintain when reflection protection is active
data_description.respect_manual_close: Don't disturb blinds that appear manually closed
data_description.manual_close_threshold_percent: Skip auto-control if tilt is below this percent (slats closed = sleep mode)

data_description.enabled: Enable automatic control for this cover
data_description.name: Optional custom name for this cover
data_description.drive_position: Position to drive cover to before tilting (0%=closed, 100%=open)
data_description.invert_tilt_percent: Invert tilt percent if cover uses reversed semantics
data_description.minimum_tilt_change_percent: Only adjust tilt if change exceeds this threshold (reduces motor wear)

apply_now.name: Apply Now
apply_now.description: Force immediate recalculation and application of slat angles to all covers, ignoring throttling rules.
